crossRefs.note: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service…
that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city…

translations.web: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
translations.bsb: The captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
translations.kjv: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
translations.asv: There the prisoners are at ease together; They hear not the voice of the taskmaster.
